faq.q: What is the origin of Aashiq?
faq.a: Aashiq is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of aashik.
Yes — the underlying form عاشق is Arabic.
Aashiq can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Aashiq should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. root ع ش ق does not occur in the Qur'an; عاشق is a normal Arabic word

faq.a: Romanization variants include Aashiq, aashiq, ashiq. Script forms are عاشق, आशिक़.
